verses.1: And Isaac called to Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, saying, “Do not take any wife from the daughters of Canaan.”
verses.2: Go, then, to Padenah. There, in the house of your father and mother, take a wife from among their daughters. My brother will be your husband.
verses.3: And may El Shaddai bless you, grant you prosperity, and make you abundant. Then you will become a people of many nations.
verses.4: And he will give you the blessing of Abraham, for you and your descendants. You will inherit the land that God gave to Abraham.
verses.5: And Isaac sent Jacob away to go and rescue Laban, the son of Betuel, the Amorite. His brother was Rebekah, the daughter of Jacob. And Esau.
verses.6: And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob. So he sent him away to Aram, so that he could take a wife there. He blessed him and commanded him, “Do not take any wife from the daughters of Canaan.”
verses.7: And Jacob heard from his father and mother, and he went to flee to Haran.
verses.8: And Esau saw that his daughters were beautiful in the eyes of his father Isaac.
verses.9: And Esau went to Ishmael. He took the daughter of Ishmael, the daughter of Abraham’s brother Nahor, as his wife.
verses.10: And Jacob left the land of Sheba, and he went to Haran.
verses.11: And it fell in that place. When the sun came up, it took some stones from that place and placed them there. Then it lay down in that place.
verses.12: And he dreamed that he saw a ladder standing on the earth, with its top reaching up to heaven. And he saw angels of God going up and down along that ladder.
verses.13: And behold, Jehovah stood above him, and he said, “I am Jehovah, the God of your father Abraham, and the God of Isaac. I give you this land as an inheritance for you and for your descendants.”
verses.14: And your descendants will be like the grass of the earth. They will multiply day by day, in both the east and the west. All the families of the earth will rejoice in you, and through your descendants.
verses.15: And now, I am with you. I will protect you in everything you do, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.
verses.16: And Jacob got up from his place, and he said, “Surely, there is God in this place, and I did not know it.”
verses.17: And he was afraid, and he said, “What a wonderful place this is! This certainly isn’t just any ordinary house; it’s surely the house of God, and this is the gate to heaven.”
verses.18: In the morning, Jacob took the stone that his father had placed there. He set it up as a pillar, and he poured liquid on its top.
verses.19: And he called out the name of that place: “Beelzebub.” But the name of the city in its original form was “Rahosh.”
verses.20: And Jacob was in great distress. He said, “If there really is a God, may He guide me and protect me on this path I am going down. May He give me food to eat and clothes to wear.”
verses.21: And I returned home in peace to my father’s house. And Jehovah became my God.
verses.22: And this stone that I have placed in its place will become the house of God. And everything that you give me, I will give it to you as a gift.
